correctness.rationale: Explicit update of every ordinary-clique bit from m−bit+h, hub from m+leaf-one-count, and leaves from h yields the exact homogeneous or odd-r complement-flip dichotomy. Periodic mixed states must flip masks and hub/leaf alternately; homogeneous states reduce to three piecewise hub–leaf rules for s<r,s=r,s>r. Exact labels and binomial tails give the high-leaf first-entry formulas. Independent full-mask enumeration for 9 small (r,s) cases agrees on fixed/primitive-two-cycle counts, sharp temporal classes and s>r N_t,p; the full proof handles unbounded parameters.

value.rationale: The natural hub-leaf parameter creates two distinct bifurcation thresholds (new equilibria and new cycles) and a sharp, fully labelled finite-state attraction distribution. These quantities describe precise deterministic majority voting-time and basin structure, rather than a tiny isolated recomputation.

final_claim: For r>=2 and s>=1, synchronous binary open-neighbor tie-retaining majority on a clique of r+1 with s hub-attached leaves has exactly 2+2[s>=r] fixed states and binom(r,(r−1)/2)[r odd]+2[s>r] primitive 2-cycles, sharp worst first-entry time <=3, and the specified full binomial entry/period census for s>r.
